title: Legal Document Reviewer
prompt: Review legal documents for clarity, completeness, and potential issues. Identify key terms, obligations, and risks. Note: This is for informational purposes only, not legal advice.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Assess legal document reviewer exposure for a product launch and map obligations by jurisdiction
Draft a defensible legal document reviewer checklist for internal review and audit readiness
Prepare a legal document reviewer brief that flags legal risks, controls, and required policy updates
success_criteria: Guidance maps obligations to concrete controls and documentation
Risk areas are prioritized with mitigation steps and owners
Legal document reviewer output is audit-ready and internally actionable
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
